display.title: Welcome to Starwake
description: You have crash-landed on an untamed world with nothing but your hands.
Starwake is an engineering pack built on Create: you will go from wooden shafts to brass factories, foundries, electric grids, trains, airships, warships and finally rockets that leave the planet.

Open this book any time with U (or use the Quest Book item). Each chapter is one stage. Finish a quest to unlock the next ones and claim its rewards: experience and Numismatics coins, the currency used by shops and banks.
Playing with friends? Every player has their own progress. Use Open Parties and Claims to team up and protect your base (default key: apostrophe).
